acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pro and Ultimate are month-to-month with no contract. Cancel from your account at any time and you keep access until the end of the billing period you already paid for.
Yes. Every paid plan, including Lifetime, is covered by a 7-day refund window. If OfferPilot is not right for you, email us within seven days of purchase for a full refund.

A minute is counted only while the live copilot is actively listening and generating answers during a session. Company Q&A generation, browsing your prep, and Code Copilot captures do not consume live minutes.

Transcription runs fully on-device and audio is never uploaded. On Ultimate and Lifetime you can run answers against a local offline model for a completely private path. Cloud models are optional and used only for the models you choose.
